name: execve
synopsis: int execve(const char *pathname, char *const _Nullable argv[], char *const _Nullable envp[]);
description: execve() executes the program referred to by pathname, replacing the current process image with a new one, including its stack, heap, and data segments. It passes command-line arguments via argv and environment variables via envp. On success, the function does not return.

parameters.name: pathname
parameters.description: Path to the executable file or script to execute.

parameters.name: argv
parameters.description: Array of strings representing command-line arguments for the new program, terminated by a null pointer; conventionally, argv[0] is the program name.

parameters.name: envp
parameters.description: Array of strings representing environment variables for the new program, in the form key=value, terminated by a null pointer.

return_value.failure: Returns -1 on error, and errno is set to indicate the error

errors.description: The total number of bytes in the environment and argument list is too large, an argument or environment string is too long, or the pathname is too long.
Search permission is denied on a component of the path, the file or interpreter is not a regular file, execute permission is denied, or the filesystem is mounted noexec.
The caller has exceeded its RLIMIT_NPROC resource limit after changing its real UID.
pathname or one of the pointers in argv or envp points outside the accessible address space.
An ELF executable has more than one PT_INTERP segment.
An ELF interpreter is a directory.
An ELF interpreter is not in a recognized format.
Too many symbolic links were encountered in resolving pathname or the interpreter, or the maximum recursion limit was reached during script interpretation.
The per-process limit on the number of open file descriptors has been reached.
The system-wide limit on the total number of open files has been reached.
The file pathname or a script interpreter does not exist.
An executable is not in a recognized format, is for the wrong architecture, or has a format error.
A component of the path prefix of pathname or the interpreter is not a directory.
The filesystem is mounted nosuid and the file has set-user-ID or set-group-ID bits set, the process is being traced, or capabilities issues prevent execution.
The specified executable is open for writing by one or more processes.
